One error, and it is the pivot typedef. da54a3c461f dropped the type expression from `@typedef {Record<string, any>} PivotAggregateDeps` in pivot_aggregation.js, which had been swallowing the five @property lines under it and leaving `deps` a bare record; with the contract restored, one aggregate-project error in pivot_model.js goes with it. The other repairs in that commit are all in the strict / noImplicitAny lock lanes, which this project does not enable, so they move this number by nothing. Measured with npx tsc --project tsconfig.json --noEmit on a clean detached worktree of da54a3c461f.

PREVIOUS NOTE, kept because a floor that loses its history costs more than the stamp gains:

STAMP REFRESHED AFTER THE REBASE, NUMBER UNCHANGED. 'npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit' emits 1490 lines matching 'error TS' at 817038bf1e7, exactly the floor, measured in a clean detached worktree with node_modules symlinked in.

PREVIOUS NOTE, kept because a floor that loses its history costs more than the stamp gains:

1497 -> 1490. Six pivot extension points were restored on web's PivotModel (_normalize, _sanitizeLabel, _getGroupValues, _getMeasureSpecs, _getMeasurements, _getCellValue), which a refactor had replaced with free functions while addons/spreadsheet still overrode all six. Five of the seven were TS4122, `this member cannot have a JSDoc comment with an '@override' tag because it is not declared in the base class`, all in addons/spreadsheet/static/src/pivot/pivot_model.js -- the compiler naming the orphaned overrides, parked inside this floor as accepted debt while the gate read green. The other two are JSDoc annotations on the new base methods. grep TS4122 is the cheap check for that whole class of silently dead override. Measured on a clean detached worktree of 5e74659f4a3.

THE DURABLE FIGURE IS STILL THE DELTA, NOT THE ABSOLUTE, and this warning is carried over from the previous stamp: the count is whole-repo and reads high on a tree with other sessions' files open. Re-measure in a detached worktree before concluding anything from it. The history of how the count reached 1497 (1513 -> 1497, thirteen of the sixteen in the field widgets, seven of those from one import shadowing the built-in Record type) lives in this file's history.
